crossRefs.note: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.
The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of…
They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.
For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done.” But…
He hired so that I would be afraid, do so, and sin, and that they might have material for an evil report, that they…
“Thus you shall speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying…
They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

people.name: Tobiah
people.line: Ammonite official who opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding efforts

translations.web: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.
translations.bsb: Moreover, these nobles kept reporting to me Tobiah’s good deeds, and they relayed my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to intimidate me.
translations.kjv: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.
translations.asv: Also they spake of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.
